ns2:course.label: Multimedia Editing and Design
ns2:course.description: Principles of visual reporting and editing; seeks to instill application-level competency in a wide array of non-linear, non-narrative techniques of journalistic storytelling across various media. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: JOUR 215.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: JOUR 215.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Journalism or Agricultural Communications or Ag Ldrship, Ed & Communication major(s). Restricted to students with Sophomore, Senior, Graduate, or Junior class standing.
